features: In-Built Subwoofer & Mic: Cameo is a powerful Bluetooth speaker wireless device featuring an in-built subwoofer speaker for deep bass performance and an integrated microphone. This sound speaker is perfect for music playback, hands-free calls, and voice interactions without the need for external accessories.

2-in-1 Powerhouse: A magnetic mini Bluetooth speaker with up to 6 hours of playback time. Compact yet powerful, this portable speaker Bluetooth device is designed to keep your music, movies, and calls going without interruption.

Modern Transparent Design with RGB Lights: Turn heads with its transparent build, vibrant RGB lighting, and sleek modern look. More than just a speaker, this small speaker Bluetooth combines premium aesthetics with immersive audio performance.

Crystal Clear Sound with Deep Bass: Equipped with a 6W powerful driver and 40mm dynamic speaker unit, this Bluetooth speaker delivers rich, punchy audio with deep bass. Ideal as a mini speaker for music, podcasts, movies, and gaming sessions.

Bluetooth V5.3 Connectivity: Enjoy faster pairing and stable wireless connections across smartphones, iPads, tablets, laptops, and desktops. This speaker Bluetooth wireless solution ensures seamless audio streaming with no drops or delays

TWS Stereo Pairing: Double the entertainment by pairing two Cameo Bluetooth speaker units together. Experience immersive True Wireless Stereo sound with enhanced audio separation, making it the perfect sound speaker setup for gaming and parties.

Long-Lasting 6-Hour Battery Life: Powered by a 600mAh battery, this portable speaker Bluetooth provides up to 6 hours of continuous playback. Features include play-while-charging support, standby auto-off, and convenient Type-C fast charging.

Pocket-Friendly & Travel-Ready: Designed as a lightweight mini speaker and small speaker Bluetooth, Cameo easily fits into your pocket. The built-in lanyard makes it perfect for walking, hiking, cycling, traveling, and enjoying music anywhere you go.
